propositions: Bare 'import alert_dedup' in scripts/canary_bridge.py and scripts/dependency_audit.py fails when those test files run as isolated subsets because scripts/ is not on sys.path

Full CI test suite passes only because tests/scripts/conftest.py inserts scripts/ to sys.path at collection time, creating a process-wide side effect that leaks into tests/unit/ but disappears in subset runs
Import failures only manifest when developers run individual test files standalone during iteration, training distrust of the test suite
Bare sibling imports must be guarded by explicit sys.path.insert calls derived from __file__ immediately above the import, matching the established pattern in jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py
A static AST-scan guard in tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py must verify that every bare sibling import under scripts/ is preceded by the required sys.path insert
